# Copilot FinOps narrative

- Open with the single most valuable action, for example reclaiming inactive seats.
- Quote figures exactly as supplied, with the currency code.
- Use the terms in `references/metrics-glossary.md`. Do not invent new metric names.
- Maximum 120 words. No bullet lists. Plain business English.
